name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
short_description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year to all land-holding farmer families.
full_description: Under the scheme, an income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments will be provided to all land-holding farmer families. The fund will be directly transferred to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Urban)
short_description: Housing for All in urban areas.
full_description: Provides central assistance to Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) and other implementing agencies for providing pucca houses to all eligible families/beneficiaries.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
short_description: Small deposit scheme for the girl child.
full_description: Aimed at the betterment of girl children in the country, currently provides a high interest rate and tax benefits under section 80C.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefit_description: High interest savings with tax benefits

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
short_description: Guaranteed minimum pension scheme.
full_description: Primarily focused on the unorganized sector workers, providing a guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month after 60 years of age.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
short_description: Loans up to 10 Lakhs for non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
full_description: Provides loans up to ₹ 10 lakh to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. These loans are classified as MUDRA loans under PMMY.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) - Post Matric
short_description: Scholarships for students from minority communities studying in class 11 to Ph.D.
full_description: The objective of the scheme is to award scholarships to meritorious students belonging to economically weaker sections of minority communities.
benefit_description: Admission & tuition fee admission + maintenance allowance

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
short_description: Health insurance cover of ₹5 Lakhs per family per year.
full_description: The world's largest health insurance/ assurance scheme fully financed by the government. It provides a cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

name: Stand-Up India
short_description: Loans between 10 Lakhs and 1 Crore for SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs.
full_description: Facilitates bank loans between 10 lakh and 1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
short_description: Deposit-free LPG gas connections for women from poor households.
full_description: Provides deposit-free LPG (cooking gas) connections to adult women from poor households, provided no LPG connection already exists in the name of any family member. Priority is given to SECC-listed households and SC/ST, PMAY-Gramin, Antyodaya Anna Yojana, and forest-dweller households; other poor households can apply via a 14-point self-declaration.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefit_description: Free LPG connection deposit waiver; ₹300 targeted subsidy per refill continues for enrolled consumers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
short_description: ₹2 lakh life insurance cover for ₹436/year, for bank account holders aged 18-50.
full_description: A government-backed term life insurance scheme available to people aged 18 to 50 with a bank or post office account. Provides a risk cover of ₹2 lakh in case of death for any reason, on payment of an annual premium of ₹436, auto-debited from the linked account. Enrollment must be renewed every year; cover can continue up to age 55 with continued premium payment.
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefit_description: ₹2 lakh life cover for an annual premium of ₹436

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
short_description: ₹2 lakh accidental death/disability cover for ₹20/year, for bank account holders aged 18-70.
full_description: A one-year, renewable accidental insurance scheme for people aged 18 to 70 with a bank or post office account. Provides accidental death or full-disability cover of ₹2 lakh, and ₹1 lakh for partial disability, for an annual premium of ₹20, auto-debited from the linked account.
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefit_description: ₹2 lakh accidental death cover (₹1 lakh for partial disability) for an annual premium of ₹20

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
short_description: Subsidized crop insurance covering losses from sowing to post-harvest.
full_description: A voluntary crop insurance scheme covering food crops, oilseeds, and notified annual commercial/horticultural crops against yield loss from natural risks - from pre-sowing failure through post-harvest damage from cyclones, unseasonal rain, and localized calamities. The farmer's premium share is capped at 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops; the remaining actuarial premium is subsidized by the Central and State governments.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_description: Crop loss coverage; farmer premium capped at 1.5-5% of the sum insured depending on season/crop

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
short_description: Collateral-free credit, skilling, and toolkit support for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
full_description: Supports artisans and craftspeople in 18 traditional family-based trades who work with their hands and tools in the unorganised sector. Provides recognition (PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card), skill upgradation training, a toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, and collateral-free credit support up to ₹1 lakh (first tranche) and ₹2 lakh (second tranche) at a concessional 5% interest rate. Applicants must not have taken a loan under similar schemes (PMEGP, MUDRA, PM SVANidhi) in the past 5 years, and benefits are limited to one member per family.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: Up to ₹3 lakh in collateral-free credit across two tranches at 5% interest, plus a ₹15,000 toolkit incentive

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
short_description: Margin-money subsidy on bank loans for setting up new micro-enterprises.
full_description: A credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up new micro-enterprises. General-category applicants can avail a margin-money subsidy of 25% of project cost in rural areas and 15% in urban areas; special categories (SC/ST/OBC/Minorities/Women/Ex-servicemen/Transgender persons/persons with disabilities, among others) can avail 35% in rural and 25% in urban areas. Maximum project cost is ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for the service sector. Loans are provided by public/private/co-operative banks, with the subsidy administered by KVIC.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: 15-35% margin-money subsidy on project cost, depending on category and location

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
short_description: Collateral-free working capital loans for street vendors, in progressive tranches.
full_description: Provides street vendors with collateral-free working capital loans in three progressive tranches (₹10,000, then ₹20,000, then ₹50,000, each on repayment of the previous one), plus a 7% annual interest subsidy credited quarterly and incentives for digital transactions. Available to urban street vendors who were vending on or before 24 March 2020, identified via a Certificate of Vending or ID card issued by their Urban Local Body.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit_description: Working capital loan starting at ₹10,000, rising to ₹20,000 then ₹50,000 across tranches
required_documents: Certificate of Vending / Vendor ID card

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
short_description: ₹12,000/year scholarship for meritorious students from low-income families, class 9-12.
full_description: Awards scholarships of ₹12,000 per year, disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer, to meritorious students of class IX in government, government-aided, and local-body schools, continuing through class XII on renewal. Students must score at least 55% in class VII (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST students) and clear a selection test, and parental income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,50,000 per annum. Applications are submitted via the National Scholarship Portal.
ministry: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
benefit_description: ₹12,000 per year, renewable through class XII

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
short_description: Cash maternity benefit for pregnant and lactating mothers.
full_description: Provides financial assistance to pregnant women and lactating mothers to support nutrition and health-seeking behaviour: ₹5,000 in installments for the first living child, and ₹6,000 for a second child if it is a girl. Excludes women in regular employment with the Central/State Government or PSUs, or already receiving similar statutory benefits.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefit_description: ₹5,000 for the first child; an additional ₹6,000 for a second child if a girl

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
short_description: Zero-balance bank account with a RuPay card, overdraft facility, and free accident cover.
full_description: India's national financial inclusion scheme. Provides a zero-balance basic savings bank account with a free RuPay debit card carrying ₹2 lakh accidental insurance cover, an overdraft facility of up to ₹10,000 after 6 months of satisfactory account operation, and Direct Benefit Transfer linkage for government subsidies. PMJDY accounts are also the entry point for PMJJBY, PMSBY, Atal Pension Yojana, and MUDRA loans.
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefit_description: Zero-balance account, RuPay card with ₹2 lakh accident cover, and up to ₹10,000 overdraft

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
short_description: Monthly stipend for SC students in classes 9 and 10 from low-income families.
full_description: Provides a monthly scholarship to Scheduled Caste students studying in classes IX and X at any recognized school, where parental/guardian income does not exceed ₹2.5 lakh per annum. Day scholars receive ₹150/month and hostellers ₹350/month, for 10 months in the academic year. States and UTs administer selection and disbursal; there is no direct central application.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
